_note: Approximate, verify. Budget and science targets are game-balance placeholders, not real mission figures. durationDays is the WHOLE mission (outbound + surface + return) and must equal the sum of the destination's phase days.

items.name: Shackleton Ice Hunt
items.objective: Land near Shackleton crater, spend 28 days on the surface through a lunar night and confirm water ice in a permanently shadowed region.

items.name: Jezero Long Stay
items.objective: Fly four crew to Jezero crater, stay 300 days studying the ancient river delta for signs of past life, and bring everyone home: about two years with no resupply.
